title: Frontend: NewTopicPage checkbox + ForumTopicPage Submit Dataset button & modal

context_files.reason: Type safety, avoid any, type guards

acceptance_criteria: NewTopicPage: checkbox toggle 'Enable dataset submissions' visible ONLY to admin/moderator users (check user.role)
NewTopicPage: checked state sent as `has_dataset_submit: true` in createTopic call
ForumTopicPage: when topic.has_dataset_submit is true, renders a 'Submit Dataset' button below the topic header
ForumTopicPage: 'Submit Dataset' button opens an inline form modal with fields: title, content, url (optional), file upload (stretch/file_url field)
Form modal submits to a new `createDatasetSubmission()` service function
Modal has loading state, error display, and closes on success
All new components follow pure-function patterns and early-return guards
